card.name: Lists of lab tests to monitor
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', or the word 'serum' inside lists of lab values to be measured, such as iPTH, serum calcium, phosphorus, creatinine, TSH. It sits just before the next lab test name.

modes.label: Joiner in lab list
modes.description: A comma or 'and' linking items in a list of lab tests to monitor.
modes.example: Closely monitor blood pressure<<,>> renal function

modes.label: Serum before a lab name
modes.description: The word 'serum' or its part 'um' leading into a lab measurement.
modes.example: Consider also assessing bone turnover status (ser<<um>> markers of bone turnover or bone biopsy)

modes.label: Table numbers
modes.description: A number in a table of measurements, such as heart wall values.

card.writes: It seems to add the next lab test name in a monitoring list, though the promoted tokens are not informative.
card.plain: It fires at the spot in a monitoring list where the next blood test, like calcium or creatinine, is about to be named.
